$ (its NAME and OPTIONS sections are what the generator reads; the fixture
$ is kept in fish-lab/fixtures/man/man1/greet.1)

$ MANPATH=<the fixture directory> fish -c fish_update_completions
Parsing man pages and writing completions to /home/hatch/workspace/fish-lab-work/home/.local/share/fish/generated_completions/

  1 / 1 : greet.1

$ what it wrote: ~/.local/share/fish/generated_completions/
greet.fish

$ the generated file, complete:
# greet
# Autogenerated from man page /home/hatch/workspace/fish-for-mere-mortals/fish-lab/fixtures/man/man1/greet.1
complete -c greet -s n -l name -d 'Who to greet.  The default is the whole world'
complete -c greet -l loud -d 'Shout the greeting in capital letters'
complete -c greet -s h -l help -d 'Show a short help text and exit.  EXAMPLES greet --name Ada --loud'
